properties.entry: SELECT a.flight_code, a.airline_code, b.airline_name, a.flight_departure, a.flight_arrival, a.flight_departure_time, a.flight_arrival_time, a.airplane_type, a.flight_gate_number, a.flight_ticket_price, a.first_created_date, a.last_modified_date FROM tbl_flight a JOIN tbl_airline b ON a.airline_code = b.airline_code ORDER BY a.flight_departure_time

SELECT a.flight_code, a.airline_code, b.airline_name, a.flight_departure, a.flight_arrival, a.flight_departure_time, a.flight_arrival_time, a.airplane_type, a.flight_gate_number, a.flight_ticket_price, a.first_created_date, a.last_modified_date FROM tbl_flight a JOIN tbl_airline b ON a.airline_code = b.airline_code WHERE b.airline_name = ? ORDER BY a.flight_departure_time

INSERT INTO tbl_flight ( airline_code, flight_departure, flight_arrival, flight_departure_time, flight_arrival_time, airplane_type, flight_gate_number, flight_ticket_price ) VALUES ( ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? )
UPDATE tbl_flight SET flight_departure = ?, flight_arrival = ?, airplane_type = ?, flight_gate_number = ? WHERE flight_code = ?
UPDATE tbl_flight SET flight_departure_time = ?, flight_arrival_time = ? WHERE flight_code = ?
UPDATE tbl_flight SET flight_ticket_price = ? WHERE flight_code = ?
